title: Linux Foundation networking: iproute2

claims_extracted.claim: The Linux Foundation page describes iproute2 as the utility collection for controlling Linux TCP/IP networking and traffic control and identifies Alexey Kuznetsov as original author.
The page says ifconfig/route are inadequate for modern environments and should be deprecated in favor of iproute2-era tooling.

notes: Useful institutional explanation of the operational migration, not a substitute for first-release chronology.
